name: The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of the earth, having laid its foundations so it would remain secure and unshaken (Psalms 104:5). From the beginning, God fashioned the earth and the heavens, suspending the earth upon nothing in His divine design (Genesis 1:1; Job 26:7). He granted mankind dominion over the earth and all its creatures, entrusting them with the responsibility to steward His handiwork (Genesis 1:26). The orderly nature of creation is further reflected in God's establishment of a compass or circle upon the earth, demonstrating His purposeful design and sustaining power (Proverbs 8:27).
